accounting_limitation: Early exploratory repair attempts did not all retain complete logical-step counters. Neither the two main-run sum nor the CPU upper bound is presented as a complete all-development checker-step total.
measured_scale_boundary: Actual campaign at most 32 requests, 21 rules per snapshot, and 84 mutations; admission caps are not measured scale.
session_cpu_interpretation: Cumulative cgroup CPU through the final scientific and paper rebuilds, including compilation and file handling; conservative upper bound for scientific CPU so far, not an isolated experimental timing or a future packaging measurement.
